target.statement: Mean F1 = 0.666 on the room-occupancy dataset (single table cell, smallest/cheapest dataset in Table II)

compute.basis: Paper reports room-occupancy runs in ~157 s on a 32-core CPU node; on 8 cores plus install, mTSBench data download, and reproducing the full pipeline (K=500 draws, 5 IFs) for one dataset, ~1-1.5 h of command time is realistic, but the repo must be checked for completeness and the mTSBench data loader must be wired up.

blockers: Repo may be incomplete/outdated (only a GitHub link, no configs verified)
mTSBench data must be fetched and matched to the paper's preprocessing (auto windowing, augmentation)
Exact F1 depends on majority-vote aggregation and adaptive threshold details that may not be fully specified
title: CRAFTIIF: Cross-Resolution Analytic Four-Type Interpretable Isolation Forest for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
